lessons.title: The Value of Patience
lessons.context: A short passage on the value of patience.

paragraphs.dari: در زندگی، صبر یک قدرت خیلی بزرگ است.
paragraphs.en: In life, patience is a very great strength.

paragraphs.dari: کاش همه می‌فهمیدند که عجله اغلب ضرر می‌رساند.
paragraphs.en: I wish everyone understood that haste often causes harm.

paragraphs.dari: کسی که با صبر کار می‌کند، در آخر موفق می‌شود.
paragraphs.en: The person who works with patience succeeds in the end.

paragraphs.dari: محنت کلید موفقیت است، اما صبر همراه آن است.
paragraphs.en: Hard work is the key to success, but patience is its companion.

paragraphs.dari: به همین دلیل، حتی در وقت سخت باید با شجاعت و صبر کار کرد.
paragraphs.en: That is why even in difficult times one should act with courage and patience.

questions.question: What does haste often cause, according to the passage?
What does the passage say is the key to success?
What is described as hard work's companion?

lessons.title: A Journey Through Culture
lessons.context: A short passage about a cultural journey.

paragraphs.dari: سارا امسال به چند کشور نو سفر کرد.
paragraphs.en: Sarah traveled to several new countries this year.

paragraphs.dari: در هر جا زبان‌های نو و رسم‌های نو دید.
paragraphs.en: Everywhere she saw new languages and new customs.

paragraphs.dari: او بیشتر از همه هنر و موسیقی آنجا را دوست داشت.
paragraphs.en: She liked the art and music there the most.

paragraphs.dari: چون او در کار تجارت هم فعالیت می‌کند، با مردم آنجا هم ملاقات کرد.
paragraphs.en: Since she also works in business, she also met people there.

paragraphs.dari: این سفر به او یاد داد که دنیا چقدر زیبا و متنوع است.
paragraphs.en: This journey taught her how beautiful and diverse the world is.

questions.question: What did Sarah do this year?
What did she like the most?
What did the journey teach her?
options: How beautiful and diverse the world is
